$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for SINHALA (si-LK): ඇලර්ජි, අසාත්මිකතාව / ආසාත්මික, නොඉවසීම, දිරවන්නේ නැහැ, සීලියැක්, ග්ලූටන් රහිත / ෆ්‍රී, <allergen> නැති / නැද්ද / නැහැ, අඩංගු නැති / නැද්ද, අඩංගු විය හැකි, දාන්න එපා, කන්න බැහැ / බැරි, ආරක්ෂිත, සඳහා සුදුසු, (හරස්) දූෂණය, ලැක්ටෝස් — plus Singlish (gluten nathi). Vowel signs, al-lakuna and anusvara are stripped on both sides, and the ZWJ of rakaransaya/yansaya becomes a space, so ෆ්‍රී is listed with and without it. Every stem is checked by its skeleton: bare දිරව (→ the skeleton of දරුවා, child) is NOT a stem, nor කිරි නැති / නැතුව (→ the skeleton of කර නැතුව, without doing), nor bare අඩංගු (what does it contain = a presence question). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
